description: Expected form fields for PDF specs (docs/PDF-FORMS.md PDFRenderResult.formFields), computed from the renderTree walk documented in repeat.json. Each case: { "name", "spec", "expected": FormFieldInfo[] } in render (document) order. FormFieldInfo: { "name": fully qualified name (enclosing FieldSet names and the field name joined with "."; when a full name repeats, later fields get "#2", "#3", ...), "type": TextInput | Checkbox | RadioGroup | Select | ListBox, "value": normalized resolved value (TextInput/RadioGroup/Select: string, or null when empty/unset; Checkbox: boolean, checked === true; ListBox: string[] when multiSelect, else string or null), "pointer": JSON Pointer the value is bound to ($state / $bindState path of value, or of checked for Checkbox; $bindItem resolved against the repeat basePath), else null ($item reads are not bindings), "options"?: resolved options of choice fields, "required" / "readOnly": true only when exactly true, "multiSelect"?: ListBox only }. Hidden elements (visible false) produce no fields.
